gaps.title: Module Alignment Details (UI Prototype vs Actual API)

guardrail.title: Guardrails
guardrail.ui: UI Prototype only needs: Name, Target (Member/Key), Spend Budget (with period). IP/Model whitelist display implemented.
guardrail.api: API is heavily over-engineered: supports token/request rate limits, monitor modes, and multiple aggregation scopes. These complexities are explicitly hidden in the UI. PATCH must reliably support whitelists.

observability.title: Observability
observability.ui: UI Prototype focuses on: Toggle and Destination management.
observability.api: API provides full Dead Letter management; however, UI does not currently need to expose these low-level retry logs. API functionality > UI.

billing.title: Billing
billing.ui: UI Prototype aggregates Balance, Transactions, and Invoices. Must enforce strict decimal precision (Requirement #66).
billing.api: Split into Credits and Transaction tags. UI handles business aggregation. Missing a unified precision control parameter.

models.title: Models
models.ui: UI Prototype is a highly integrated 'Experience Center'.
models.api: Split into Catalog (metadata) and Agent (runtime). Lacks a one-stop aggregated API like the UI, requiring multiple frontend calls. Significant optimizations in Requirement #63.

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.ui: UI Prototype has implemented: Scope (Personal/Workspace/Member), limits, and expiration. Requirement #14.
apiKeys.api: Swagger v1.2 is severely outdated: missing scope, spending_limit, and expires_at fields. API should align with UI definitions ASAP.

organization.title: Org & Members
organization.ui: UI Prototype needs: Logo upload (Requirement #1780294522906), total member count, and member filtering from the full org list.
organization.api: Major API gaps: Missing POST /tenants/:id/avatar; TenantItem lacks member_count; missing filtered 'non-project org members' endpoint.

invitation.title: Invitations
invitation.api: POST /invitations must reliably support workspace_id and auto_join. Current API support status is unclear.
